model_claims.text: After the fix, keyword mock names from patch.multiple (including additional_patchers) are removed from funcargnames so they are not treated as fixture requests.
model_claims.source_quote: `getfuncargnames()` already removes positional mocks from `patch` and `patch.object`. This change also removes keyword mock names from `patch.multiple`, including its `additional_patchers`.

model_claims.text: Only parameters corresponding to patch.multiple arguments with DEFAULT are excluded; those with explicit values remain fixture requests.
model_claims.source_quote: Only attributes patched with `DEFAULT` are excluded, for both `unittest.mock` and the PyPI `mock` package. Attributes patched with explicit values do not supply mock arguments, so matching parameters remain fixture requests.

model_claims.text: Positional mock handling continues to be removed from funcargnames as before, unchanged by the fix.
A fixture sharing the name with a DEFAULT mock is no longer invoked to supply that argument; previously the fixture would run then be overridden.
model_claims.source_quote: A fixture with the same name as a `DEFAULT` mock is no longer set up just to supply that argument. Previously the fixture ran, but `patch.multiple` replaced its value with the mock anyway.

model_claims.text: When a test is parametrized with a name that is a DEFAULT mock from patch.multiple and no other fixture provides it, collection now fails with "function uses no argument 'bar'", whereas before the test would run (one case) with the mock overriding the parameter.
model_claims.source_quote: A separate local probe combined `@pytest.mark.parametrize("bar", [1])` with `@patch.multiple(Foo, bar=DEFAULT)`. The base ran one case with the mock replacing the parameter value. With this patch, and no other fixture requirement for `bar`, collection fails with `function uses no argument 'bar'`.

model_claims.text: The previously failing patch_multiple integration tests now pass after applying the fix, whereas they failed on the base commit.
model_claims.source_quote: With the same regression file overlaid on base `9efd0121a`, the command reported **2 failed, 20 deselected**: the signature check kept the mock-owned names, and the pytester cases failed with `fixture 'bar' not found`. On `8e97ca14e`, it reported **2 passed, 20 deselected**.
